零星.pinyin: chí táng lǐ piāo fú zhe líng xīng de jǐ piān luò yè
零星.en: A few fragments of dead leaves floated on the pond.

风味.zh: 充分氧化反应赋予红茶浓郁醇厚的风味和深琥珀色。
风味.pinyin: chōng fèn yǎng huà fǎn yìng fù yǔ hóng chá nóng yù chún hòu de fēng wèi hé shēn hǔ pò sè
风味.en: Full oxidation gives black tea its deep, robust flavor and dark amber color.

间.zh: 我不知道我是否有时间做。
间.pinyin: wǒ bù zhī dào wǒ shì fǒu yǒu shí jiān zuò
间.en: I don't know if I'll have time to do it.
间.es: Yo no sé si tengo tiempo para hacerlo.

间.zh: 我要预订一间6月3日的单人房。
间.pinyin: wǒ yào yù dìng yī jiān yuè rì de dān rén fáng
间.en: I'd like to reserve a single room on June 3.
间.es: Me gustaría reservar una habitación individual para el 3 de junio.

间.pinyin: nǐ yǒu shí jiān zài zuò ba
间.en: Do it when you have time.

间.zh: 给你解释这为什么行不通要花很多时间。
间.pinyin: gěi nǐ jiě shì zhè wèi shén me xíng bu tōng yào huā hěn duō shí jiān
间.en: It would take me too much time to explain to you why it's not going to work.
间.es: Me llevaría demasiado tiempo explicarte por qué no va a funcionar.

东京.zh: 东京是一个很大的城市。
东京.pinyin: Dōng jīng shì yī ge hěn dà de chéng shì
东京.es: Tokio es una ciudad muy grande.

东京.zh: 伦敦的气候和东京的不同。
东京.pinyin: Lún dūn de qì hòu hé Dōng jīng de bù tóng
东京.en: London's climate differs from that of Tokyo.
东京.es: El clima de Londres es distinto al de Tokio.

东京.zh: 我有两个儿子，一个在东京，另一个在名古屋。
东京.pinyin: wǒ yǒu liǎng gè r zi yī ge zài Dōng jīng lìng yī gè zài Míng gǔ wū
东京.en: I have two sons; one is in Tokyo, and the other in Nagoya.
东京.es: Tengo dos hijos: uno está en Tokio y el otro en Nagoya.

东京.pinyin: Rì běn de shǒu dū shì Dōng jīng
东京.en: The capital of Japan is Tokyo.
东京.es: La capital de Japón es Tokio.

几个.zh: 我在医院里住了几个礼拜。
几个.pinyin: wǒ zài yī yuàn lǐ zhù le jǐ ge lǐ bài
几个.en: I stayed in hospital for a few weeks.
几个.es: Estuve en el hospital por unas semanas.

几个.zh: 我买了几个鸡蛋和一点牛奶。
几个.pinyin: wǒ mǎi le jǐ ge jī dàn hé yī diǎn niú nǎi
几个.en: I bought a few eggs and a little milk.
几个.es: Compré algunos huevos y un poco de leche.

几个.pinyin: wǒ xū yào jǐ ge yī jià
几个.en: I require a few clothes hangers.

几个.zh: 她有时会一动不动的坐上好几个小时。
几个.pinyin: tā yǒu shí huì yī dòng bù dòng de zuò shàng hǎo jǐ ge xiǎo shí
几个.en: She will sometimes sit still for hours.

晚饭.zh: 穿上你的鞋，我们出去吃晚饭。
晚饭.pinyin: chuān shang nǐ de xié wǒ men chū qù chī wǎn fàn
晚饭.en: Put on your shoes. Let's go out for dinner.
晚饭.es: Ponte los zapatos y vamos a cenar.

晚饭.zh: 好的，但我们先吃晚饭吧。
晚饭.pinyin: hǎo de dàn wǒ men xiān chī wǎn fàn ba
晚饭.en: Sure, but let's eat dinner first.
晚饭.es: Vale, pero vamos a cenar primero.

晚饭.pinyin: wǎn fàn hòu wǒ xǐ le wǎn dié
晚饭.en: I washed the dishes after supper.
晚饭.es: Fregué los platos después de cenar.

晚饭.pinyin: wǒ jīn tiān yào zhǔn bèi wǎn fàn
晚饭.en: I have to cook dinner today.
晚饭.es: Tengo que cocinar la cena hoy.

头.zh: 野兔被乌龟抛了在后头。
头.pinyin: yě tù bèi wū guī pāo le zài hòu tou
头.en: The hare was outdistanced by the tortoise.
头.es: La liebre fue adelantada por la tortuga.

头.zh: 我头撞到了门，肿了一块。
头.pinyin: wǒ tou zhuàng dào liǎo mén zhǒng le yī kuài
头.en: I bumped my head against the door and got a lump.

头.zh: 我为了乘头班火车，一大早就起了床。
头.pinyin: wǒ wèi le chéng tou bān huǒ chē yī dà zǎo jiù qǐ le chuáng
头.en: I got up early in order to catch the first train.

头.zh: 可以唱首披头四的歌给我听吗？
头.pinyin: kě yǐ chàng shǒu pī tou sì de gē gěi wǒ tīng ma
头.en: Will you sing me a Beatles' song?

整.pinyin: wǒ kū le yī zhěng wǎn
tā kū le yī zhěng wǎn
tā yī zhěng wǎn dōu zài kū
整.en: She kept crying all night long.
整.es: Ella estuvo llorando toda la noche.

整.zh: 我打算八点整在房里吃早餐。
整.pinyin: wǒ dǎ suàn bā diǎn zhěng zài fáng lǐ chī zǎo cān
整.en: I'd like breakfast in my room at 8 sharp.
整.es: Me gustaría desayunar en mi habitación a las ocho en punto.

出国.zh: 看来他出国学习的目的是要提高他说英语的能力。
出国.pinyin: kàn lai tā chū guó xué xí de mù dì shì yào tí gāo tā shuō Yīng yǔ de néng lì
出国.en: It seems that the purpose of his study abroad was to improve his ability to speak English.
出国.es: Al parecer, su propósito de estudiar en el extranjero es desarrollar su capacidad para hablar el inglés.

出国.pinyin: tā chū guó liú xué le

做饭.zh: 除非是你做饭，否则我是不会吃的。
做饭.pinyin: chú fēi shì nǐ zuò fàn fǒu zé wǒ shì bù huì chī de
做饭.en: I won't eat it unless you cooked it.
做饭.es: No lo voy a comer a menos que lo hayas preparado tú.

做饭.pinyin: wǒ qī zi zhèng zài zuò fàn
做饭.en: My wife is cooking right now.

做饭.zh: 她喜欢为她的家人做饭。
做饭.pinyin: tā xǐ huan wèi tā de jiā rén zuò fàn
做饭.en: She likes cooking for her family.
做饭.es: Le gusta cocinar para su familia.

做饭.pinyin: wǒ mèi mei zhèng zài chú fáng zuò fàn
做饭.en: My sister is cooking in the kitchen.
做饭.es: Mi hermana está cocinando en la cocina.

一人.zh: 你永远不会孤身一人的。
一人.pinyin: nǐ yǒng yuǎn bù huì gū shēn yī rén de
tā men qí zhōng yī rén shì jiàn dié
一人.en: One of them is a spy.
一人.es: Uno de ellos es un espía.

一人.zh: 她独自一人去了墨西哥。
一人.pinyin: tā dú zì yī rén qù le Mò xī gē
一人.en: She went to Mexico by herself.
一人.es: Ella se fue a México sola.

度假.pinyin: wǒ děng bù jí yào qù dù jià
度假.en: I can't wait to go on a vacation.
度假.es: No puedo esperar para salir de vacaciones.

度假.zh: 去度假的时候我要租辆车。
度假.pinyin: qù dù jià de shí hou wǒ yào zū liàng chē
度假.en: When I go on vacation, I'll rent a car.
度假.es: Cuando me vaya de vacaciones alquilaré un coche.

度假.zh: 当我们开始像自己护照上的照片时，我们该去度假了。
度假.pinyin: dāng wǒ men kāi shǐ xiàng zì jǐ hù zhào shàng de zhào piàn shí wǒ men gāi qù dù jià le
度假.en: When you're beginning to look like the photo in your passport, you should go on a holiday.
度假.es: Cuando empieces a parecerte a la foto de tu pasaporte deberías irte de vacaciones.

度假.pinyin: wǒ xià zhōu yào qù dù jià
度假.en: I'm going on vacation next week.
度假.es: Me voy de vacaciones la próxima semana.

好朋友.pinyin: nǐ hé wǒ shì hǎo péng you
好朋友.en: You and I are good friends.
好朋友.es: Tú y yo somos buenos amigos.

好朋友.zh: 我和他从小就是好朋友了。
好朋友.pinyin: wǒ hé tā cóng xiǎo jiù shì hǎo péng you le
好朋友.en: He and I have been good friends since we were children.
好朋友.es: Él y yo somos buenos amigos desde que éramos pequeños.

好朋友.zh: 我和一个外国的学生做了好朋友。
好朋友.pinyin: wǒ hé yī ge wài guó de xué sheng zuò le hǎo péng you
好朋友.en: I made friends with a student from abroad.
好朋友.es: Me hice amigo de una estudiante extranjera.

好朋友.pinyin: wǒ yǒu jǐ ge hǎo péng you

交谈.zh: 我们所有的人用英语交谈。
交谈.pinyin: wǒ men suǒ yǒu de rén yòng Yīng yǔ jiāo tán
交谈.en: All of us talk in English.

交谈.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu cān yù jiāo tán
交谈.en: I didn't take part in the conversation.
交谈.es: No tomé parte en la conversación.

交谈.zh: 我希望能再一次和你交谈。
交谈.pinyin: wǒ xī wàng néng zài yī cì hé nǐ jiāo tán
交谈.en: I would like to talk with you again.
交谈.es: Me gustaría volver a hablar contigo.

交谈.zh: 我或许不善于社交,但这并不意味我不和别人交谈。
交谈.pinyin: wǒ huò xǔ bù shàn yú shè jiāo dàn zhè bìng bù yì wèi wǒ bù hé bié ren jiāo tán
交谈.en: I may be antisocial, but it doesn't mean I don't talk to people.
交谈.es: Yo puedo ser antisocial, pero eso no significa que no hable con la gente.

一会.pinyin: wǒ men guo yī huì zài tán
tā zài nà li zhàn le yī huì
一会.en: He stood there for a while.
一会.es: Se paró ahí por un rato.

一会.pinyin: wǒ xiū xi yī huì méi wèn tí ba
一会.en: Is it okay if I take a break?

一会.zh: 我犹豫了一会，不知道走哪条路才好。
一会.pinyin: wǒ yóu yù le yī huì bù zhī dào zǒu nǎ tiáo lù cái hǎo
一会.en: I hesitated about which road to take.
一会.es: Yo dudaba sobre qué camino tomar.

瑞士.zh: 瑞士是一个中立的国家。
瑞士.pinyin: Ruì shì shì yī ge zhōng lì de guó jiā

瑞士.zh: 在中国的旁边，瑞士像一个荒废的乡村似的。
瑞士.pinyin: zài Zhōng guó de páng biān Ruì shì xiàng yī ge huāng fèi de xiāng cūn shì de
瑞士.en: Next to China, Switzerland is an abandoned village.
瑞士.es: Comparado con China, Suiza es una aldea abandonada.

瑞士.zh: 如果把瑞士熨了，会比德国还要大。
瑞士.pinyin: rú guǒ bǎ Ruì shì yùn le huì Bǐ Dé guó hái yào dà
瑞士.en: If you ironed Switzerland, it would be bigger than Germany.
瑞士.es: Si plancharas Suiza, esta sería más grande que Alemania.

瑞士.zh: 瑞士以它的风景优美而闻名。
瑞士.pinyin: Ruì shì yǐ tā de fēng jǐng yōu měi ér wén míng
瑞士.en: Switzerland is famous for its scenic beauty.
瑞士.es: Suiza es famosa por su belleza escénica.

更加.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng gèng jiā zì lì
更加.en: I want to be more independent.

更加.zh: 他不会说英文，德文就更加不用说了。
更加.pinyin: tā bù huì shuō Yīng wén Dé wén jiù gèng jiā bù yòng shuō le
更加.en: He cannot speak English, much less German.
更加.es: Él no sabe hablar inglés, mucho menos alemán.

更加.zh: 我希望你更加努力地工作。
更加.pinyin: wǒ xī wàng nǐ gèng jiā nǔ lì de gōng zuò
更加.en: I want you to work harder.

更加.zh: 人会随著年龄的增长而更加地玩世不恭。
更加.pinyin: rén huì suí zhe nián líng de zēng zhǎng ér gèng jiā de wán shì bù gōng
更加.en: People grow more cynical with age.
更加.es: Con la edad la gente se vuelve más cínica.

篮球.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan dá lán qiú
wǒ men zài tǐ yù guǎn dá lán qiú
篮球.en: We played basketball in the gym.
篮球.es: Jugamos a baloncesto en el gimnasio.

篮球.pinyin: ràng wǒ men fàng xué hòu dá lán qiú
篮球.es: Juguemos al baloncesto después de la escuela.

篮球.pinyin: wǒ xǐ huan kàn lán qiú bǐ sài

忠告.pinyin: tā gěi le tā yī ge zhōng gào
忠告.en: He gave her a piece of advice.

忠告.pinyin: tā de zhōng gào zǒng shì hěn míng zhì
忠告.en: His advice is always very sensible.
忠告.es: Sus consejos son siempre muy sensatos.

忠告.pinyin: tā bù gù wǒ de zhōng gào

忠告.zh: 如果他听了我的忠告，他现在就是一个有钱人了。
忠告.pinyin: rú guǒ tā tīng le wǒ de zhōng gào tā xiàn zài jiù shì yī ge yǒu qián rén le
忠告.en: If he had taken my advice, he would now be rich.

美味.zh: 我父亲为我做了一顿美味的午餐。
美味.pinyin: wǒ fù qīn wèi wǒ zuò le yī dùn měi wèi de wǔ cān
美味.en: My father made me a delicious lunch.
美味.es: Mi padre me hizo un delicioso almuerzo.

美味.zh: 我所有的蛋糕都很美味!
美味.pinyin: wǒ suǒ yǒu de dàn gāo dōu hěn měi wèi
nǐ de dàn gāo hěn měi wèi
nín de dàn gāo hěn měi wèi

开会.pinyin: xiàn zài shì bu shì gāi kāi huì le
开会.en: Shall we start the meeting now?

开会.pinyin: wǒ hái yǐ wéi tā huì lái kāi huì
开会.en: I had expected him at the meeting.
开会.es: Esperaba que él asistiera al encuentro.

开会.zh: 我会告诉她开会的时候说些什么。
开会.pinyin: wǒ huì gào su tā kāi huì de shí hou shuō xiē shén me
开会.en: I will tell her what to say at the meeting.
开会.es: Le diré qué tiene que decir en la reunión.

开会.zh: 他开会的时候一句话也没有说。
开会.pinyin: tā kāi huì de shí hou yī jù huà yě méi yǒu shuō
开会.en: He kept silent during the meeting.
开会.es: Él guardó silencio durante la reunión.

礼拜.zh: 我们在意大利的时候，租车用了一个礼拜 。
礼拜.pinyin: wǒ men zài yì dà lì de shí hou zū chē yòng le yī ge lǐ bài
礼拜.en: We hired a car for a week when we were in Italy.
礼拜.es: Alquilamos un coche durante una semana cuando fuimos a Italia.

礼拜.zh: 我上个礼拜把她介绍给你了。
礼拜.pinyin: wǒ shàng ge lǐ bài bǎ tā jiè shào gěi nǐ le
礼拜.en: I introduced her to you last week.
礼拜.es: Te la presenté la semana pasada.

礼拜.zh: 我在医院里住了几个礼拜。
礼拜.pinyin: wǒ zài yī yuàn lǐ zhù le jǐ ge lǐ bài
礼拜.en: I stayed in hospital for a few weeks.
礼拜.es: Estuve en el hospital por unas semanas.

礼拜.pinyin: wǒ liǎng gè lǐ bài jiù huì huí lai
礼拜.en: I will be back in two weeks' time.

有一点.pinyin: wǒ duì nǐ yǒu yī diǎn shēng qì
有一点.en: I'm a little angry with you.

有一点.pinyin: wǒ yǒu yī diǎn shī wàng

有一点.zh: 关于我，有一点你应该了解，我恐高。
有一点.pinyin: guān yú wǒ yǒu yī diǎn nǐ yīng gāi liǎo jiě wǒ kǒng gāo
有一点.en: Something you should know about me is that I'm afraid of heights.
有一点.es: Algo que deberías saber acerca de mí es que le tengo miedo a las alturas.

有一点.pinyin: bù shì yǒu yī diǎn xiǎo ma

挺好.pinyin: wǒ tǐng hǎo de nǐ ne
wǒ dǎo jué de tǐng hǎo de

挺好.zh: 我对美国的印象挺好的。
挺好.pinyin: wǒ duì Měi guó de yìn xiàng tǐng hǎo de
挺好.en: My impression of America is very good.

挺好.pinyin: wǒ tīng shuō tā men tǐng hǎo

笔记.zh: 我把笔记落在宿舍了，我现在就回去拿。
笔记.pinyin: wǒ bǎ bǐ jì là zài sù shè le wǒ xiàn zài jiù huí qu ná
笔记.en: I left the notes in the dormitory. I'll go back and get them now.
笔记.es: He dejado las notas en la residencia. Vuelvo cogerlas ahora.

笔记.zh: 我把笔记放在宿舍了，现在回去拿。
笔记.pinyin: wǒ bǎ bǐ jì fàng zài sù shè le xiàn zài huí qu ná
笔记.en: I left the notes in the dormitory. I'll go back and get them now.
笔记.es: He dejado las notas en la residencia. Vuelvo cogerlas ahora.

笔记.zh: 把这些生字写进你的笔记簿内。
笔记.pinyin: bǎ zhè xiē shēng zì xiě jìn nǐ de bǐ jì bù nèi
笔记.en: Write these words in your notebook.
笔记.es: Escribe estas palabras en tu cuaderno.

笔记.pinyin: nǐ yīng gāi zuò bǐ jì

贴.zh: 别忘了在你的信上贴张邮票。
贴.pinyin: bié wàng le zài nǐ de xìn shàng tiē zhāng yóu piào
贴.en: Don't forget to put a stamp on your letter.
贴.es: No olvides pegar el sello a la carta.

贴.zh: 我忘记在信封上贴邮票了。
贴.pinyin: wǒ wàng jì zài xìn fēng shàng tiē yóu piào le
贴.en: I forgot to attach a stamp to the envelope.
贴.es: Olvidé pegar un sello en el sobre.

贴.zh: 他在手上贴了一块胶布。
贴.pinyin: tā zài shǒu shàng tiē le yī kuài jiāo bù
贴.en: He put a Band-Aid on his hand.
贴.es: Se puso una tirita en la mano.

贴.zh: 把另一张邮票贴在信封上。
贴.pinyin: bǎ lìng yī zhāng yóu piào tiē zài xìn fēng shàng
贴.en: Stick another stamp on the envelope.

放进.zh: 你一把它放进去，就不能把牛奶和咖啡分开了。
放进.pinyin: nǐ yī bǎ tā fàng jìn qù jiù bù néng bǎ niú nǎi hé kā fēi fēn kāi le
放进.en: You cannot separate the milk from the coffee once you put it in.
放进.es: No se puede separar la leche del café una vez que la hayas metido.

放进.zh: 你如果能把全副精力放进去，要学会英文并不是难事。
放进.pinyin: nǐ rú guǒ néng bǎ quán fù jīng lì fàng jìn qù yào xué huì Yīng wén bìng bù shì nán shì
放进.en: If you concentrate all your energies on the study of English, you will master the language.
放进.es: Si concentras todas tus energías en el estudio del inglés, dominarás el idioma.

放进.zh: 她把脏盘子放进水池里。
放进.pinyin: tā bǎ zāng pán zi fàng jìn shuǐ chí lǐ
